items.title: Chipotle (CMG) Debuts Pollo Asado And Chili Lime Chips
items.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill (NYSE:CMG) introduced an updated Pollo Asado recipe and new Chili Lime Chips as limited time menu items. The Chili Lime Chips are based on a viral fan trend, reflecting how the company is reacting to social media driven ordering habits. This is the first time Chipotle has launched two limited time offerings at the same time, signaling a shift in its menu rollout approach.
